tasks.label: Decode JSON
args: const fs = require('fs'); try { const text = fs.readFileSync('${file}', 'utf8').trim(); const decoded = Buffer.from(text, 'base64').toString('utf8'); const json = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(decoded), null, 2); const outFile = '${file}'.replace('-Encoded.txt', '-Decoded.json').replace('.txt', '.json'); fs.writeFileSync(outFile, json); console.log('✅ Success! Created: ' + outFile); } catch(e) { console.error('❌ Error decoding file:', e.message); }
